name: Google Veo 3.1
role: Final-quality cinematic shots in 16:9 with native sound; openers, establishing shots, short spoken lines

pricing.note: 720p costs the same as 1080p on this tier. Iterate on veo-fast, render the keeper here.

gotchas: Whatever the prompt names, Veo draws, and negativePrompt does not stop it. Naming a camera brand printed the brand in the corner; naming a polo shirt embroidered a logo. Describe without brand names.
Close-ups of faces with high energy drift into grimaces. Keep a SHOT: line with medium shot or wider.
Light: one source with a direction and a ratio (about 4:1), not 'bright' or 'cinematic'. 'Bright white room with big windows' comes back washed out.
No face continuity between calls. For several people speaking, describe a different person in each shot instead of chasing the same one.
9:16 is limited to 720p in practice; e-learning is 16:9 anyway.
